chapter.verse: Pasian' deihna hangin Khris Jesu' sawltak khat ahi keimah Paul leh i sanggampa Timothy in Corinth khua-a om Pasian' pawlpi leh Achaia gamke bup-a om mi siangthote khempeuh kong hopih uh hi.
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Pasian leh i Topa Jesu Khris ii Pa, thukhualna tuamtuamte' Pa, leh vai khempeuh hong dinpih Pasian in thuphangah ta hen.
Amah pen kote' gentheihna khempeuh ah hong dinpih Pasian hi a, tua pen gentheihna khatpeuh a tuakte ama' hong dinpihna nam tawh ka dinpih theih nading uh ahi hi.
A hang pen Khris' hangin gimthuakna a tampi ka tuahkhak mah bangun Khris' tungtawnin dinpihna zong a tampi ka ngah uh hi.

Gentheih haksat ka tuah uhleh dinpihna leh hotkhiatna na ngah nading uh hi a, dinpihna ka ngah uhleh zong nomau' ading ahi hi. Dinpihna ka cih ciangin kote' tuahkhak gimthuakna nam lungduaitak na thuak uh ciangin na ngah ding pen uh ahi hi.
Kote' gimthuakna nong thuakpih uhleh kote' ngah dinpihna zong ngah ding na hihlam uh thei ka hih manun note' ading ka lametna uh kiling lo hi.
A hang pen sanggamte aw, Asia gam sunga ka tuahkhak uh gimna thu na theih loh ding uh ka deih kei uh hi. Komau' thaneihzah val vangik hong kisuat manin nuntak ding lamet bei-in ka om uh hi.
Ci taktak lehang, sih thukhenna a ngah khin danin ka kingaihsun uh hi. Ahih hangin tua pen koleko kimuangkha lo-in misite a thosak Pasian' tungah ka kingakh theih nading uh nahi hi.
Amah in tua zaha a suksia sihtheihna pan kote hong honkhia khin banah hong honkhia lai ding hi. Hong honkhia kikkik lai ding hi ci-in zong ama' tungah lametna ka nei uh hi.
Mi tampite' thungetsakna tawh ka ngah uh hehpihna gah hangin mi tampi mah in kote' taangin lungdam a ko ahih theih nadingin note in zong thungetna tawh nong huh ding uh ahi hi.

A hang pen kote' kisialhpih thu, kote' kitheihtawmna lungsim in teci a pan thu, hih bang ahi hi: Pasian' zia tawh kituak lungsim siangtho leh ngimna siangtho tawh—cilesa pilna tawh hilo-in Pasian' hehpihna tawh—leitung ah, a diakdiakin note' tungah, kong gamta uh hi.
A hang pen note' simtheih ding leh teltheih ding thu longal a dang kong gelh kei uh a, a kicingin telthei lai dingin zong kong lamen uh hi.
A langbai-in nong tel khitsa uh ahih mah bangin i Topa Jesu hong pai ni ciangin note hong kisialhpih ding uh a, note in zong kote nong kisialhpih ding uh hi.
Hih thu lungmuang ka hih manin nihveina na hamphat theih nadingun note' kiangah kong pai masa nuam hi.
Macedonia ka zuatlamin note' kiangah hong hawh ding, ciahlam ciangin zong note' kiangah hong pai ding, Judea gam ka zuat ding ciangin zong note hong kikhasak ding, cih pen ka ut ahi hi.
Tua bang ka ut pen a lungka kawikawi ka hi hiam? “Himah, himah” leh “Hilo, hilo” a ci nemnum dingin ka vaigeelnate ah cilesa a bulphuh ka hi hiam?
Pasian muanhuai ahih mah bangin note' tunga kong thugen uh pen Himah hi zel, Hilo hi zel, cih bang hilo hi.
A hang pen kei tawh, Silvanus tawh, Timothy tawh, ko teng in note' kianga kong tangko uh Pasian' Tapa, Jesu Khris pen Himah leh Hilo ahikhawm hilo-in ama' sungah Himah hi tawntung hi.
A hang pen Pasian' kamciamte a vekpi-in ama' sungah Himah hi pah hi. Jesu Khris hangin Pasian' tungah minphatna pia-in Amen i cihna zong tua thu hang mah ahi hi.
Khris sungah note tawh kote hong lamkhawmin eite sathau hong nilh pen Pasian ahi hi.
Amah in khamkholhna dingin i tungah ama' ciaptehna gip hong belhin i lungtang sungah ama' Kha hong guan hi.
Ahi zongin Corinth khua kong paikik loh pen note kong mapna hi, cih kei' nunna kha lamah teci pang dingin Pasian ka ko hi.
Na upna uh hong ukbawl ka hikei uh a, na upna uhah kiptak dingtang na hih manun note' nuam nadingin note tawh hong semkhawm ka hizaw uh hi.
